resources.string: Observatory compares upper culminations across the Location’s year to find the annual maximum and minimum heights.
Mid-height entries show the actual culminations nearest the mean of the annual extremes, retaining every increasing and decreasing passage.
Tap an observation date and time to apply that instant to the Location and pause time at 0×, preserving position, altitude and resumption choices.
Annual calculations use the effective Location and time zone, including daylight saving; incomplete orbital coverage is clearly indicated.
Each object remembers independent Observatory and Daily path scroll positions throughout the current session.
Scroll positions survive navigation, rotation and backgrounding; temporary loading and selected-point centering do not erase a consulted position.
